definitions.explanation: A negative consequence imposed for wrongdoing or breaking rules.

examples.japanese: {嘘|うそ}をついたら{罰|ばつ}が{当|あ}たる。
examples.english: If you lie, you'll be punished (by fate).
examples.notes: {罰|ばつ}が{当|あ}たる suggests divine or karmic punishment.

examples.japanese: {罰|ばつ}として{掃除|そうじ}をさせられた。
examples.english: As punishment, I was made to clean.

notes:
{罰|ばつ} can refer to formal punishments or karmic/divine retribution.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {罰|ばつ}を{受|う}ける: to receive punishment
- {罰|ばつ}を{与|あた}える: to give punishment
- {罰|ばつ}が{当|あ}たる: to be punished (by fate/karma)
- {罰金|ばっきん}: fine (monetary penalty)
- {罰|ばつ}ゲーム: penalty game (in game shows)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刑罰|けいばつ}: criminal punishment
- {処罰|しょばつ}: punishment, penalty (formal)
